_about: What Radar watches. Edit this file (or ask Claude) to add or change interests. The daily update reads it.

diet.note: Prefer 100% gluten-free kitchens that are also vegan (covers dairy and eggs). Always flag oat milk / oat flour risk.

spots.name: Scheveningen
spots.note: Beach faces WNW. SW to N is on/side-shore; anything from the east is offshore.

spots.name: Oostvoornse Meer
spots.note: From the south beach, S and SE blow offshore. Adjust if you launch elsewhere.

spots.name: Amstelmeer
spots.note: Guessed as your lake near Groet, all directions for now. Tell Claude your launch side to refine.

museums.taste: Contemplative art in nature and in strong architecture: land art, sculpture parks, light and space, zen, Tadao Ando, Isamu Noguchi, Dani Karavan, James Turrell. Liked: Murou Art Forest, D.T. Suzuki Museum (Kanazawa).

restaurants.rule: High ratings (4.4+), and genuinely safe for gluten-free, dairy-free, egg-free and oat-free eating.
extras: new openings that suit the diet

watch: new work by Ted Chiang, Denis Villeneuve, Gregory David Roberts, Anodea Judith

meditation.what: Zen and silent retreats, meditation classes and meetups
meditation.where: Den Haag / Rotterdam, Netherlands, and Japan while travelling

work.what: Climate adaptation finance: events, conferences, calls for startups, accelerator and grant deadlines
